alert_data.message:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 31-A #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 3:03 AM, 11 September 2026(Friday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(Subic, San Antonio, Olongapo, Castillejos) and Bataan(Morong, Hermosa, Dinalupihan, Samal, Orani, Bagac, Abucay, Balanga).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila(Manila, Quezon City, Caloocan, Valenzuela, Malabon, Navotas, San Juan), Bulacan(Obando, Marilao, Meycauayan, Bulakan, Malolos, Paombong, Hagonoy, Norzagaray, San Jose del Monte, Calumpit, Baliuag, Santa Maria, Pandi, Bustos, Bocaue, Balagtas, Guiguinto, Plaridel, Pulilan, Dona Remedios Trinidad), Pampanga(Masantol, Macabebe, Lubao, Sasmuan, Floridablanca, Apalit, San Simon, San Luis, Minalin, Guagua, Santo Tomas, Bacolor, Santa Rita, San Fernando, Porac, Candaba), Zambales(Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz, San Felipe, San Narciso), Bataan(Limay, Mariveles, Orion, Pilar), Rizal(Rodriguez) and Tarlac(Bamban, Capas, San Jose).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Pampanga(Arayat, Magalang, Mexico, Santa Ana, Angeles, Mabalacat), Bulacan(Angat, San Miguel, San Rafael, San Ildefonso), Metro Manila(Makati, Mandaluyong, Pasay, Paranaque, Las Pinas, Muntinlupa, Taguig, Pasig, Pateros, Marikina), Rizal(Antipolo, San Mateo, Tanay, Angono, Baras, Binangonan, Cainta, Cardona, Jala-Jala, Morong, Pililla, Taytay, Teresa), Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Camiling, Mayantoc, Moncada, San Clemente, Santa Ignacia), Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Lucban, Mauban, Real, Sampaloc, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Burdeos, Calauag, Guinayangan, Gumaca, Jomalig, Lopez, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Perez, Plaridel, Polillo, Quezon, Tagkawayan), Laguna(Santa Maria, Mabitac, Pakil, Famy, Siniloan, Pangil), Cavite(Ternate, Maragondon, Naic, Tanza, Rosario, Noveleta, Cavite City, Kawit, Bacoor) and Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
